1.w: These [were] the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,

2.w: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

3.w: The sons of Judah: Er, and Onan, and Shelah; [these] three were born to him of a daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er the firstborn of Judah was wicked in the eyes of YHWH, and He put him to death.

4.w: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore to him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah [were] five.

5.w: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

6.w: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara; five of them in all.

7.w: And the son of Carmi: Achar troubler of Israel, who transgressed regarding the devoted thing.

8.w: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.

9.w: And the sons of Hezron who were born to him: Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.

10.w: And Ram begat Amminadab, and Amminadab begat Nahshon, a leader of the sons of Judah.

11.w: And Nahshon begat Salmon, and Salmon begat Boaz,

12.w: and Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,

13.w: and Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimea the third,

14.w: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

15.w: Ozem the sixth, [and] David the seventh.

16.w: And their sisters [were] Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel—three.

17.w: And Abigail bore Amasa, and the father of Amasa [was] Jether the Ishmaelite.

18.w: And Caleb son of Hezron had children by Azubah [his] wife and by Jerioth. And these [were] her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.

19.w: And Azubah died, and Caleb took as his wife Ephrath, and she bore to him Hur.

20.w: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezalel.

21.w: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir father of Gilead, and he married her. And he [was] a son of sixty years, and she bore to him Segub.

22.w: And Segub begat Jair, and he had unto him twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

23.w: And Geshur and Aram took Havvoth-jair, with Kenath and its daughters—sixty towns. All these [were] the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

24.w: And after the death of Hezron in Caleb-ephrathah, the wife of Hezron, Abijah, bore to him Ashhur father of Tekoa.

25.w: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: The firstborn Ram, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, [and] Ahijah.

26.w: And to Jerahmeel was another wife, and her name [was] Atarah. She [was] the mother of Onam.

27.w: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were: Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.

28.w: And the sons of Onam were: Shammai and Jada. And the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

29.w: And the name of the wife of Abishur [was] Abihail, and she bore to him Ahban and Molid.

30.w: And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. And Seled died without sons.

31.w: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.

32.w: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan. And Jether died without sons.

33.w: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

34.w: Unto Sheshan there were no sons, but only daughters. And unto Sheshan [was] a servant, an Egyptian, and his name [was] Jarha.

35.w: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant for a wife, and she bore to him Attai.

36.w: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,

37.w: and Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,

38.w: and Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

39.w: and Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,

40.w: and Eleasah begat Sismai, and Sismai begat Shallum,

41.w: and Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

42.w: And the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn (he [was] the father of Ziph), and his son Mareshah, the father of Hebron.

43.w: And the sons of Hebron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.

44.w: And Shema begat Raham the father of Jorkoam, and Rekem begat Shammai.

45.w: And a son of Shammai [was] Maon, and Maon [was] the father of Beth-zur.

46.w: And Ephah, concubine of Caleb, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez. And Haran begat Gazez.

47.w: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.

48.w: The concubine of Caleb, Maacah, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

49.w: And she gave birth to Shaaph the father of Madmannah [and to] Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb [was] Acsah.

50.w: These were the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim,

51.w: Salma the father of Bethlehem, [and] Hareph the father of Beth-gader.

52.w: And the sons Shobal the father of Kiriath-jearim were: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,

53.w: and the clans of Kiriath-jearim—the Ithrite, and the Puthite, and the Shumathite, and the Mishraite. From these came the Zorathite and the Eshtaolite.

54.w: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, and the Netophathite, Atroth-beth-joab, and half the Manahathite, the Zorite,

55.w: and the clans of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez—the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, [and] the Suchathites. These [are] the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
